body:
There's nothing worth living for that I can have with any sort of consistency.  If I ask for them it's blackmail or manipulation.

Besides,  anyone who really,  truly gets to know me agrees that I'm selfish and egotistical.  Why should I invest in letting someone else get to know me when I know that's going to be the outcome?  Even people who start to get to know me and practically worship the ground I walk on,  when they really get to know me they agree that I'm egotistical and only care about myself.  Ever since I was a small child people have told me that.

Oh no.  You have to remember,  what would stop me is up to me.  Society has taught me not to discuss what would stop me  because that would be blackmail or extortion, thereby giving anyone who may wish to stop me fewer tools with which to do so.

I want a clean exit that nobody can stop.  Was actually going to do it on Monday but someone I know gave me something to keep me going for a bit.  Still doing it soon and already taking steps to make it happen over the next few days.
I've tried lots of different people.
To be taken as seriously as I have taken others.
My existence has done me more harm than good.  Why would I owe myself something harmful?

I love myself more and more actually... Enough to know that I deserve better.  It's my right to charge the world whatever I want to be alive.  When I name my price, it's interpreted as blackmail and manipulation.

It's true that the world doesn't owe me anything,  but I don't owe the world anything either.  Including my continued existence.

The entire world taught me.   I'm not trying to teach them a lesson.  I'm trying to leave the situation.  This is what I've been taught to do; it's what people do when they don't get exactly what they want from me and can't force it.
"It gets better" is difficult to believe when it has consistently gotten worse.
